description: (transaction, trader type) pairs whose share is at or above their trader type's average share are kept.

c.request: Link the `advancedbehavior` records to their transaction via `translink` and on to the trader who made it (skip anything that doesn't match), and count records for each transaction (`translink`) and trader type combination. Each combination's share is its count over the total for its trader type. Looking only at combinations whose share sits on the upper side of the average share for their trader type, give me, per trader type, the average count, the average share, and the average margin over the trader type's average share — no rounding. (transaction, trader type) pairs whose share is at or above their trader type's average share are kept.
c.sql: WITH joined_data AS (SELECT ab.translink, tr.tradekind FROM advancedbehavior ab INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg), counted_data AS (SELECT translink, tradekind, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM joined_data GROUP BY translink, tradekind), with_shares AS (SELECT translink, tradekind, record_count, CAST(record_count AS FLOAT) / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) as share FROM counted_data), avg_shares AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(share) as avg_share_for_type FROM with_shares GROUP BY tradekind), filtered AS (SELECT ws.translink, ws.tradekind, ws.record_count, ws.share, aspt.avg_share_for_type FROM with_shares ws INNER JOIN avg_shares aspt ON ws.tradekind = aspt.tradekind WHERE ws.share >= aspt.avg_share_for_type) SELECT tradekind, AVG(record_count) as avg_count, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(share) - MAX(avg_share_for_type) as avg_margin FROM filtered GROUP BY tradekind

d.request: Count advancedbehavior records per (transaction, trader type) pair as a share of the trader type's total; retain pairs with share ≥ trader type's average share; per trader type report the average count, average share, and average margin over the trader type's average share of retained pairs.
d.sql: WITH pair_counts AS (SELECT ab.translink, t.tradekind, COUNT(*) as pair_count FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY ab.translink, t.tradekind), trader_totals AS (SELECT tradekind, SUM(pair_count) as type_total FROM pair_counts GROUP BY tradekind), pair_shares AS (SELECT pc.translink, pc.tradekind, pc.pair_count, CAST(pc.pair_count AS FLOAT) / tt.type_total as pair_share FROM pair_counts pc JOIN trader_totals tt ON pc.tradekind = tt.tradekind), trader_type_avg_share AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(pair_share) as avg_share FROM pair_shares GROUP BY tradekind), retained_pairs AS (SELECT ps.translink, ps.tradekind, ps.pair_count, ps.pair_share FROM pair_shares ps JOIN trader_type_avg_share ttas ON ps.tradekind = ttas.tradekind WHERE ps.pair_share >= ttas.avg_share), final_stats AS (SELECT rp.tradekind, AVG(rp.pair_count) as avg_count, AVG(rp.pair_share) as avg_share, AVG(rp.pair_share - ttas.avg_share) as avg_margin FROM retained_pairs rp JOIN trader_type_avg_share ttas ON rp.tradekind = ttas.tradekind GROUP BY rp.tradekind) SELECT tradekind, avg_count, avg_share, avg_margin FROM final_stats ORDER BY tradekind

a.request: Take the behavioural analysis records in `advancedbehavior`, link each to its transaction through `translink` and then to the trader who made that transaction (dropping records with no match), and count the records for each pair of linked transaction (`translink`) and trader type. Work out each pair's share as its count divided by the total count of all pairs with the same trader type, and keep only the pairs whose share is greater than or equal to the average share of pairs of their trader type. For each trader type, return the trader type, the average record count of the kept pairs, their average share, and the average amount by which their share exceeds the trader type's average share, without rounding.
a.sql: WITH joined_data AS (SELECT ab.translink, t.tradekind, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM advancedbehavior ab INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY ab.translink, t.tradekind), pair_stats AS (SELECT translink, tradekind, record_count, record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) as share FROM joined_data), type_avg AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(share) as avg_share_for_type FROM pair_stats GROUP BY tradekind), kept_pairs AS (SELECT ps.translink, ps.tradekind, ps.record_count, ps.share, ta.avg_share_for_type FROM pair_stats ps JOIN type_avg ta ON ps.tradekind = ta.tradekind WHERE ps.share >= ta.avg_share_for_type) SELECT tradekind, AVG(record_count) as avg_record_count, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share_for_type) as avg_excess_share FROM kept_pairs GROUP BY tradekind ORDER BY tradekind

b.request: Group advancedbehavior records by (transaction, trader_type) via the linking chain, count per group, calculate each group's share as count divided by that trader type's total count, retain groups where share ≥ the trader type's mean share, and report per trader type the mean count, mean share, and mean margin (mean of each group's share minus the trader type's mean share) for retained groups.
b.sql: WITH linking AS (SELECT ab.abhvreg, tr.transreg, t.tradereg, t.tradekind FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg), group_stats AS (SELECT transreg, tradekind, COUNT(*) as group_count FROM linking GROUP BY transreg, tradekind), trader_totals AS (SELECT tradekind, SUM(group_count) as total_count FROM group_stats GROUP BY tradekind), with_shares AS (SELECT g.transreg, g.tradekind, g.group_count, CAST(g.group_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_count as share FROM group_stats g JOIN trader_totals t ON g.tradekind = t.tradekind), mean_shares AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(share) as mean_share_per_type FROM with_shares GROUP BY tradekind), with_margins AS (SELECT w.transreg, w.tradekind, w.group_count, w.share, m.mean_share_per_type, w.share - m.mean_share_per_type as margin FROM with_shares w JOIN mean_shares m ON w.tradekind = m.tradekind), filtered_groups AS (SELECT transreg, tradekind, group_count, share, margin FROM with_margins WHERE share >= mean_share_per_type), final_stats AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(group_count) as mean_count, AVG(share) as mean_share, AVG(margin) as mean_margin FROM filtered_groups GROUP BY tradekind) SELECT tradekind, mean_count, mean_share, mean_margin FROM final_stats ORDER BY tradekind;
b.raw: Group advancedbehavior records by (transaction, trader_type) via the linking chain, count per group, calculate each group's share as count divided by that trader type's total count, retain groups where share ≥ the trader type's mean share, and report per trader type the mean count, mean share, and mean margin (mean of each group's share minus the trader type's mean share) for retained groups.
